verdict.rationale: PostHog's generic HTTP capture API (posthog-docs-11) could technically be used to backfill historical events, and community evidence notes Mixpanel-library compatibility to ease switching (posthog-comm-5), while the AI wizard advertises it can 'migrate you from another vendor' (posthog-docs-37). However, there is no dedicated bulk-import/historical-backfill tool, no documented event-timestamp override guidance, and no case study of importing a data export from another analytics tool. Missing for 10: a documented bulk-import or backfill endpoint/tool, guidance on historical timestamp handling, and independent confirmation of a successful cross-platform migration.
